# plaintshirtsuk.com

> Plain Fruit of the Loom T-shirts from €6.95, 10 for €40.95: prices, bulk calculator and guides to the best plain tees, white and black tees and fabric weight.

## Key facts

- Plain Fruit of the Loom T-shirts are sold by Marmalade Co. (marmaladeco.com) from 1 piece at €6.95, with fixed pack prices: 3 for €14.95, 5 for €22.95 and 10 for €40.95 (approx. €4.10 each). Prices incl. VAT, checked 16 October 2026.
- Marmalade Co. delivers with DHL to Ireland, Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal and Spain: €6 to a pickup point (free from €80) or €7 for home delivery, dispatched in 0 to 1 working day and delivered in about 2 to 3 working days. It does not currently deliver to the United Kingdom.
